indexes_on_students.name: uq_students_b_form
indexes_on_students.sql: CREATE UNIQUE INDEX uq_students_b_form ON students (replace(replace(replace(b_form, '-', ''), ' ', ''), '.', '')) WHERE b_form IS NOT NULL AND b_form <> ''
